outcome: Episodes of rescue IV ephedrine administration
Hypotension (decrease in MAP > 25% of baseline MAP)
cohort: The participants were patients undergoing caesarean section who received spinal anaesthesia.
finding: The control group experienced significantly more episodes of rescue IV ephedrine administration compared to both the ephedrine and phenylephrine treatment groups, with no significant difference found between the ephedrine and phenylephrine groups themselves.
